notes.title: Baobabs Mausoleum: EP 1 gets its first and major update
notes.notes: Watracio Walpurgis is getting a newer version of Flamingos’ Creek. This September 21th, Baobabs Mausoleum Ep1. will receive an important optimization related to the graphics and also to the controller support. Besides, minor collision and important achievements (Time Dungeon and getting gummies) bugs are fixed.
